title: Everything (God in My Living)
lyrics: God, in my [C]living, there in my [Fmaj7]breathing,
God, in my [Am]waking, God, in my [G6]sleeping...
God, in my [C]resting, there in my [Fmaj7]working,
God, in my [Am]thinking, God, in my [G]speaking...
God, in my hoping, there in my dreaming,
God, in my watching, God, in my waiting...
God, in my laughing, there in my weeping,
God, in my hurting. God, in my healing...
[F]Christ in me[G], Christ in me[Am], Christ in me,
[F]Christ in me[G], Christ in me[Am], Christ in me,

sourceMetadata.presentation: V1 C V2 C B C2 C2
